formal_statement:
theorem ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.LocalKeyArraySemantics.seg_flatMap_rows {α : Type*} {μ : ℕ → ℤ} (xs : List α)
    (f : α → List ℤ) (n dst : ℕ)
    (hlen : ∀ x ∈ xs, (f x).length=n)
    (hread : ∀ (j : ℕ) (hj : j < xs.length) (i : ℕ) (hi : i < n),
      μ (dst+j*n+i)=(f xs[j])[i]'(by rw [hlen _ (List.getElem_mem hj)]; exact hi)) :
    _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.Light.Seg μ dst (xs.flatMap f) := by sorry
natural_language_statement:
Let $A$ be any type, $X$ a list in $A$, $F:A\to\operatorname{List}(\mathbb Z)$ a row map, $n,b\in\mathbb N$, and $\mu$ an integer memory. Suppose every row $F(x)$ for $x\in X$ has length $n$ and

$$\mu(b+jn+i)=F(X_j)_i\qquad(j<|X|,\ i<n).$$

Then the contiguous segment beginning at $b$ is exactly the flattened list $\operatorname{flatMap}(F,X)$.

This identifies rowwise machine writes with the flat key-array layout consumed downstream.
